fusions.name: Ledge to Ledge
fusions.desc: Bounds you up to 7 tiles onto the target and deals 16 damage, leaving it [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nipping Bound
fusions.desc: Hops in on a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Cliff Skip
fusions.desc: Bounds you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it, with 15% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Springing Gait
fusions.desc: Each stretch of ground you cover raises your physical damage by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
